title: About
text:
Write a short academic biography here. Aim for a professional tone, and keep it current. Most visitors decide whether your work is relevant to them within the first minute, so prioritise clarity over exhaustive detail.
You may wish to include a one paragraph version for casual readers, and a longer version for academic audiences.
